kinematic_audit.stage: carry shirt in front of line
carry shirt in front of line
present held left hem above peg
lower empty hand clear of line
approach peg handles from the side
feed flexible hem into open jaw
ease handles open to close peg slowly

source_waypoints: Same exposed-hem pickup with a10 mm deeper bite; native031 identified right forearm/line collision and cloth slip. Fifteen-degree upward finger approach keeps wrist below line; cloth waits 80 mm in front of handles. No online object feedback.

offline_rejection_audit.limitation: Does not certify continuous collisions, robot tracking, cloth physics or grasp success
offline_rejection_audit.check: collision-hull vertices against fixtures/opposite-arm hulls (0.5 mm); finite cylinder axes clipped against whole hulls (0.2 mm)

do_not_run_reason: Native batch033 held the shirt but dangling fabric knocked the target peg off before opening. Preserve as failed diagnostic evidence; use isolated empty-peg control before corrected feed.
